visualCharacteristics.layout: Wide scrollable table with sticky part column, part-number filter, result count, pagination (10/page) and CSV download
visualCharacteristics.notes: Parametric part table (application-driven): results count "1-10 of 38 results", NRND checkbox, Download XLS button, part-number filter, columns Part, Order, CAD Model, Status, Core count, Core Type, Lockstep, Operating Frequency, Flash ...; rows per part number linking to part pages; pagination 1-4.

contentPattern.structure: header row of parameter names then one row per part (first cell = part number link); up to 32 columns

reuseGuidance: Use for large part/parameter data; filter matches the first column.
